scenes.setting: Justice's account of the Hero Bandit draws Alger's guess about the vanishing colonial slaves and a careful admission — 'My adorer made some minor contributions'; the Sheriff and Interrogator characteristics go on sale (600 pounds, reserved for Fors), Audrey teaches the Law of Beyonder Characteristics Conservation, and Roselle's number-and-date symbols are given free before the gathering closes
scenes.text_anchor: “My adorer made some minor contributions in this matter.”
